description: Manage a bare metal server in the Packet Host (a “device” in the API terms).

parameters.name: always_pxe
parameters.description: Persist PXE as the first boot option. Normally, the PXE process happens only on the first boot. Set this arg to have your device continuously boot to iPXE. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Packet API token. You can also supply it in environment variable PACKET_API_TOKEN.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of devices to create. Count number can be included in hostname using the %d string formatter. Default: 1

parameters.name: count_offset
parameters.description: From which number to start the count. Default: 1

parameters.name: device_ids
parameters.description: List of device IDs on which to operate.

parameters.name: facility
parameters.description: Facility slug for device creation. See Packet API for current list - https://www.packet.net/developers/api/facilities/.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Dict with “features” for device creation. See Packet API docs for details.

parameters.name: hostnames
parameters.description: A hostname of a device, or a list of hostnames. If given string or one-item list, you can use the "%d" Python string format to expand numbers from count. If only one hostname, it might be expanded to list if count>1.

parameters.name: ipxe_script_url
parameters.description: URL of custom iPXE script for provisioning. More about custom iPXE for Packet devices at https://help.packet.net/technical/infrastructure/custom-ipxe. Default: ""

parameters.name: locked
parameters.description: Whether to lock a created device. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: operating_system
parameters.description: OS slug for device creation. See Packet API for current list - https://www.packet.net/developers/api/operatingsystems/.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.description: Plan slug for device creation. See Packet API for current list - https://www.packet.net/developers/api/plans/.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: ID of project of the device.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Desired state of the device. If set to present (the default), the module call returns immediately after the device-creating HTTP request successfully returns. If set to active, the module call blocks until all the specified devices are in state active due to the Packet API, or until wait_timeout. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "active" "inactive" "rebooted"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: List of device tags. Currently implemented only for device creation.

parameters.name: user_data
parameters.description: Userdata blob made available to the machine.

parameters.name: wait_for_public_IPv
parameters.description: Whether to wait for the instance to be assigned a public IPv4/IPv6 address. If set to 4, it waits until IPv4 is assigned to the instance. If set to 6, it waits until public IPv6 is assigned to the instance. Choices: 4 6

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: How long (seconds) to wait either for automatic IP address assignment, or for the device to reach the active state. If wait_for_public_IPv is set and state=active, the module waits for both events consequently, applying the timeout twice. Default: 900

examples:
# All the examples assume that you have your Packet API token in environment variable PACKET_API_TOKEN.
# You can also pass it to the auth_token parameter of the module instead.

# Creating devices

- name: Create 1 device
  hosts: localhost
  tasks:
    - community.general.packet_device:
        project_id: 89b497ee-5afc-420a-8fb5-56984898f4df
        hostnames: myserver
        tags: ci-xyz
        operating_system: ubuntu_16_04
        plan: baremetal_0
        facility: sjc1

# Create the same device and wait until it is in state "active", (when it is
# ready for other API operations). Fail if the device is not "active" in
# 10 minutes.

- name: Create device and wait up to 10 minutes for active state
  hosts: localhost
  tasks:
    - community.general.packet_device:
        project_id: 89b497ee-5afc-420a-8fb5-56984898f4df
        hostnames: myserver
        operating_system: ubuntu_16_04
        plan: baremetal_0
        facility: sjc1
        state: active
        wait_timeout: 600

- name: Create 3 ubuntu devices called server-01, server-02 and server-03
  hosts: localhost
  tasks:
    - community.general.packet_device:
        project_id: 89b497ee-5afc-420a-8fb5-56984898f4df
        hostnames: server-%02d
        count: 3
        operating_system: ubuntu_16_04
        plan: baremetal_0
        facility: sjc1

- name: Create 3 coreos devices with userdata, wait until they get IPs and then wait for SSH
  hosts: localhost
  tasks:
    - name: Create 3 devices and register their facts
      community.general.packet_device:
        hostnames: [coreos-one, coreos-two, coreos-three]
        operating_system: coreos_stable
        plan: baremetal_0
        facility: ewr1
        locked: true
        project_id: 89b497ee-5afc-420a-8fb5-56984898f4df
        wait_for_public_IPv: 4
        user_data: |
          #cloud-config
          ssh_authorized_keys:
            - {{ lookup('file', 'my_packet_sshkey') }}
          coreos:
            etcd:
              discovery: https://discovery.etcd.io/6a28e078895c5ec737174db2419bb2f3
              addr: $private_ipv4:4001
              peer-addr: $private_ipv4:7001
            fleet:
              public-ip: $private_ipv4
            units:
              - name: etcd.service
                command: start
              - name: fleet.service
                command: start
      register: newhosts

    - name: Wait for ssh
      ansible.builtin.wait_for:
        delay: 1
        host: "{{ item.public_ipv4 }}"
        port: 22
        state: started
        timeout: 500
      with_items: "{{ newhosts.devices }}"


# Other states of devices

- name: Remove 3 devices by uuid
  hosts: localhost
  tasks:
    - community.general.packet_device:
        project_id: 89b497ee-5afc-420a-8fb5-56984898f4df
        state: absent
        device_ids:
          - 1fb4faf8-a638-4ac7-8f47-86fe514c30d8
          - 2eb4faf8-a638-4ac7-8f47-86fe514c3043
          - 6bb4faf8-a638-4ac7-8f47-86fe514c301f

return_values.name: devices
return_values.description: Information about each device that was processed.
